g.text: the region each piece goes in, or none
the trail, the panel with its buttons, the keys -
placed in the screen's own regions, so the
declared tree is left exactly as it was
the values the form opens on, and who is there
every key but the one that leaves is dropped
deal() and share(), where a grid puts blocks side by side
flow the Region's blocks from both ends, scroll if declared
aborts from anywhere, including an open field
[a button, work to run, leaving, or the wheel]
held here: none of the four acts on a block -
the wheel moves the region the cursor is in,
leaving the cursor on the row it was on
the focused block, if it binds that key
move the cursor, open a field, go into a panel,
come back out, show a field's help
rows that follow the answers re-resolve,
computed values recompute, conditions show and
hide rows and whole sections, fix-ups apply
resolve one query, once the whole read is spent
restore(), and clear unless the session opted out
